method: Live HTTP checks (curl) on the stratified sample; full-site on-disk crawl of site/ HTML (BeautifulSoup) for distributions, link graph and schema; Lighthouse 13.5.0 mobile on 4 URLs. Read-only.
passes: https everywhere; http -> https 301 single hop
.html -> clean URL 308 single hop; trailing-slash variants 308 single hop
canonical present, https, clean, self-referential on all 32 sampled live pages and 961/966 pages on disk (missing only on /graph, /graph-cosmos, /board, /links, /about)
robots.txt valid, allows all incl. AI crawlers, declares sitemap
noindex correctly on /admin, /rate (and about 404 pages); none of them in sitemap
meta description present on 966/966 indexable pages, 962 within 70-160 chars
OG + Twitter summary_large_image on all sampled pages; 112 /og/*.jpg cards are exactly 1200x630 with og:image:width/height (guides, deeper, hubs)
JSON-LD parses on all pages (0 errors); Article has headline, datePublished, dateModified, author, image; BreadcrumbList valid
Entry pages have rel=prev/next sequential links and median 9 inlinks (min 2); no orphan entries/guides/deeper
No broken internal links except /go/* which resolve via _redirects (302)
Hidden guide prerender exists on all 63 guides and covers >=80% of markdown words on every one (see SEO-01 for why it is still a problem)

findings.title: Guide bodies are client-rendered; the only server HTML copy is a visually-hidden, aria-hidden, lossy prerender
findings.evidence: All 63 guides ship an empty <div id="guide-body"> filled at runtime by marked+DOMPurify from <script type="text/markdown">. The server-side copy lives in <div class="sr-index" aria-hidden="true" style="position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;clip:...">. Verified complete in word terms (prerender median 4,736 words vs markdown 5,142; 0 of 63 under 80%), BUT it is lossy: 0 <a> links (markdown has a median of 22 external citations per guide), no <ul>/<pre>/<code>, and shell "# comment" lines inside code fences become <h1> (hunyuan3d-2 has 5 H1s such as "<h1>clone code (small)", blender-mcp-tripo-pipeline 15, n8n-mcp-and-obsidian-skills 18). Server-HTML visible words outside the hidden div: median 130, 34 of 63 guides under 150. Non-JS crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, CCBot, most AEO fetchers) therefore read only hidden text with no links; Googlebot gets the content twice in the rendered DOM (hidden + visible), i.e. 2 H1s on every guide. Hidden text whose only purpose is crawlers is the pattern Google spam policies describe, even when identical to visible text.
findings.fix: scripts/build_guides.py: render the markdown to HTML at build time (python-markdown or mistune with fenced_code + tables) directly into #guide-body; remove the marked/DOMPurify <script> tags and the client render block; scripts/search_prep.py: stop emitting .sr-index for guides (point data-pagefind-body at #guide-body instead). Keep the <script type="text/markdown"> only if something else reads it (prompt-system copy buttons), otherwise drop it to halve HTML weight.
findings.expected_impact: Full linked content for every crawler without JS; removes duplicate/hidden text and multi-H1; guide LCP should drop roughly 1-2 s on mobile (Lighthouse attributes 1,053 ms to marked and 184 ms to DOMPurify as render-blocking, LCP element is the JS-inserted first paragraph with 2.2 s render delay).

findings.title: Home and catalog block rendering on a 2.7 MB catalog.js (798 KB brotli) loaded synchronously
findings.evidence: index.html and catalog.html include <script src="catalog.js"> and <script src="deep_dives.js"> (273 KB raw) as parser-blocking scripts. Lighthouse mobile: /catalog performance 35, FCP=LCP 7.6 s, TBT 1,161 ms, TTI 11.8 s, main-thread work 20.4 s, render-blocking est. 5.58 s (catalog.js alone 6.1 s). Home performance 66, TBT 583 ms, TTI 7.8 s, 889 KB of script transferred. Home only needs counts/featured items from it.
findings.affected_estimate: 2 pages (home + catalog) — the two highest-authority URLs
findings.fix: scripts/catalog_js.py: emit a small catalog-index (id,title,tier,collection,thumb) and lazy-load full records on demand; add defer to all non-critical scripts in index.html/catalog.html; scripts/build_landing_meta.py: give the home page the few numbers it needs inline instead of loading catalog.js. Server-render the first 24-48 catalog cards into catalog.html so LCP is static HTML.
findings.expected_impact: Catalog LCP from 7.6 s toward <2.5 s (passes Core Web Vitals LCP); home TBT/INP improves; both hubs become crawlable without JS.

findings.title: Internal links point at .html URLs that 308-redirect, and the site nav exists only in JavaScript
findings.evidence: Static HTML contains 16,487 internal hrefs ending in .html across 961 pages (e.g. 2,508x href="../catalog.html", 846x "../index.html", entry prev/next "Dd6W2q5gZJ-.html"); every one costs a 308 hop to the clean URL. The nav is built by shared.js DV.nav() with BASE+"catalog.html", "start-here.html", "prompts.html", "search.html", "graph.html", "board.html" — also .html. Because nav is JS-only, /start-here, /links, /graph, /graph-cosmos and /board have 0 static inlinks; /start-here and /search are unreachable from / in a no-JS crawl. llms.txt and llms-full link .html URLs too.
findings.fix: scripts/render_entries.py, scripts/build_guides.py, scripts/deeper_dives.py, scripts/render_template.py, site/shared.js (DV.nav BASE+...): emit clean root-relative URLs (/catalog, /e/<id>, /guides/<slug>) everywhere; render the nav as static <nav> HTML in the page templates (JS may enhance it). scripts/check_links.py: fail the build on any internal href ending .html.
findings.expected_impact: Removes ~16k redirecting links from Google's link graph (redirects leak crawl budget and consolidate signals slowly on a new site with 13 of 20 sampled URLs "discovered - not indexed"); puts start-here and the nav hubs into the static graph.

findings.title: Entry pages sit 3-5 clicks deep in the static link graph; the catalog hub has no crawlable links to them
findings.evidence: BFS over static HTML from /: guides at depth 2, deeper at 3, entries at 3 (306), 4 (416) and 5 (124). /catalog server HTML has 0 <a> to entries and 277 words (cards are rendered from catalog.js). /e/ (the static all-entries index, 848 links) is linked only from the 846 entry pages themselves, not from home or catalog. Home links statically only to /catalog and /guides/.
findings.fix: scripts/render_template.py / site/index.html and catalog.html: add a static link to /e/ ("Browse all 846 entries") and to /start-here, /prompts in a server-rendered nav/footer; add per-collection or per-tier static index pages (e.g. /e/?c=quant is not crawlable — use /collections/<slug>) generated by scripts/render_entries.py so every entry is within 2-3 clicks of home.
findings.expected_impact: Shallower discovery path and stronger internal PageRank to the long tail; helps move entries out of "discovered - currently not indexed".

findings.title: Entry pages have no primary-entity schema, no image on the page, and undersized og:images
findings.evidence: All 846 /e/ pages carry only Organization + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD (no CreativeWork/SocialMediaPosting/VideoObject describing the entry). They contain 0 elements. og:image is /thumb/.jpg with no og:image:width/height; of 876 thumbs, 569 are under 600 px wide, 250 are 600-1199, only 3 are 1200x630; 155 exceed 100 KB (max 2 MB, all JPEG). summary_large_image cards and Google Discover want >=1200 px wide.
findings.fix: scripts/build_seo.py: add a CreativeWork (or SocialMediaPosting with sharedContent url) node per entry with name, description, author=creator Person with url, datePublished=entry date, image, isBasedOn=source post URL, about=tools/techniques; add og:image:width/height. scripts/build_og.py: generate 1200x630 cards for entries (title + thumb) like the guide cards. scripts/render_entries.py: show the thumbnail with width/height/alt/loading="lazy" and emit a 480w WebP.
findings.expected_impact: Eligibility for image search and richer link previews; clearer entity understanding for Google and AI answer engines.

findings.title: Home page Cumulative Layout Shift 0.323 (poor; threshold 0.25)
findings.evidence: Lighthouse mobile on https://dejaviewed.dev/: CLS 0.323, culprit "body > main#lp > section.sec" (2 layout shifts) — content injected after load by landing_meta.js/catalog.js pushes the section down. Guide, entry and catalog CLS are 0.
findings.fix: scripts/build_landing_meta.py + site/index.html: server-render the numbers/featured blocks or reserve their height with min-height/aspect-ratio in shared.css; avoid inserting content above existing sections after first paint.
findings.expected_impact: Home passes CLS in field data once CrUX accumulates; better first impression for the most-linked URL.

findings.title: Every sitemap <lastmod> and every Article dateModified is the build date
findings.evidence: 969 of 974 sitemap URLs have <lastmod>2026-10-22</lastmod>; all 108 Article nodes (63 guides + 45 deeper) have dateModified 2026-10-22 regardless of whether the content changed. Google stops trusting lastmod that changes without content changes; uniform dates also make the "Updated" signal meaningless for answer engines.
findings.fix: scripts/build_api.py (sitemap) and scripts/build_seo.py (dateModified): compute per-page content hashes, persist {url: [hash, last_changed]} in data/seo/lastmod.json, and only bump lastmod/dateModified when the hash changes (or use git log -1 --format=%cs on the source markdown/catalog row).
findings.expected_impact: Restores lastmod as a crawl-prioritisation signal so real updates get recrawled quickly.

findings.title: Sitemap lists low-value and non-HTML URLs
findings.evidence: sitemap.xml includes /graph, /graph-cosmos, /board (no canonical, no meta description, no H1, no JSON-LD, 0 static inlinks), /search (internal search, 49 words, empty without a query), 6 /api/*.json files, /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt and /feed.xml. JSON/TXT/XML cannot rank and dilute the sitemap's quality ratio; /e/ (the static all-entries index, canonical https://dejaviewed.dev/e/) is missing.
findings.fix: scripts/build_api.py: emit only canonical, indexable HTML pages; add /e/; add <meta name="robots" content="noindex,follow"> to search.html; for graph/graph-cosmos/board either add canonical + description + H1 + intro copy via scripts/build_seo.py or noindex them. Keep API/llms discoverable via robots.txt, llms.txt and <link rel="alternate">.
findings.expected_impact: Cleaner signal for Search Console coverage; fewer "crawled - not indexed" URLs.

findings.title: Soft-404s: unknown and wrong-case URLs return 200 with the homepage
findings.evidence: /this-does-not-exist -> 200 (homepage HTML); /e/depygagfdim (lowercased valid id DepYGAgFDiM) -> 200 homepage; /deeper/ -> 200 homepage (there is no deeper index page). Noted per brief: the 404 fix is in progress by another agent — listed only so it is tracked; the extra cases to include are case-variant entry ids and the missing /deeper/ index.
findings.fix: In progress (site/404.html by other agent). Also: generate site/deeper/index.html (list of 45 deeper dives) in scripts/deeper_dives.py, or 301 /deeper/ -> /guides/ in site/_redirects.
findings.expected_impact: Prevents soft-404 classification and duplicate-of-homepage noise in Search Console.

findings.title: Titles are long: 789 of 966 indexable titles exceed 70 characters
findings.evidence: Title length median 80 chars; >60 chars on 796 entries, 57 guides, 45 deeper. Example entry: "Lifestyle Magazines — editorial layout & design reference scans — DejaViewed" (77). Google truncates around 580-600 px (~55-60 chars), so the brand suffix and often the differentiating half are cut and Google rewrites many of them. Uniqueness is good: only 1 duplicate title pair ("Comment “agent” to get my Claude code guides — DejaViewed").
findings.fix: scripts/render_entries.py (entry <title>), scripts/build_guides.py, scripts/deeper_dives.py: keep the subject first, trim to <=60 chars, drop " — DejaViewed" when the title would exceed 60, and rewrite the "Comment “agent”..." pair (call-to-action captions are poor titles).
findings.expected_impact: Higher CTR from fuller, un-rewritten titles.

findings.title: Guide and deeper-dive twins share the same meta description
findings.evidence: 46 description values are used twice (92 pages): each /deeper/deeper-insight-<slug> reuses its /guides/<slug> description (e.g. "The art market's gatekeeping structure — galleries, curators..." on /guides/art-market-disruption, /deeper/deeper-insight-art-market-disruption and /e/DZZxvq7IPeE). 669 descriptions are machine-truncated with "…" at ~155 chars.
findings.fix: scripts/build_seo.py: derive deeper descriptions from the deeper page's own lede; end descriptions on a sentence boundary under 155 chars instead of hard truncation with an ellipsis.
findings.expected_impact: Distinct snippets for the two pages per topic; less cannibalisation between guide and deeper twin.

findings.title: H1 and heading-hierarchy defects
findings.evidence: 12 guides have 2-18 H1s in server HTML (code-comment bug, see SEO-01); after client render every guide has 2 H1s. /catalog, /graph, /graph-cosmos, /board have no H1. All 846 entry pages jump H1 -> H3 (Lighthouse heading-order fails on entry and catalog); all 45 deeper pages also skip levels.
findings.fix: SEO-01 fixes guides. scripts/render_entries.py: make the tableau section headings H2 (".level h3" -> h2, keep the styling in CSS). catalog.html / graph / board templates: add one visible H1.
findings.expected_impact: Cleaner document outline for crawlers and screen readers (accessibility score 86 on catalog).

findings.title: FAQPage markup on all 63 guides earns no rich result and its Q/A pairs do not match
findings.evidence: Since August 2023 Google shows FAQ rich results only for well-known authoritative government and health sites, so the 63 FAQPage nodes (254 questions) produce no SERP feature. Worse, answers do not answer their questions: gemini-cli Q "Are the quotas and model names in my notes from Google's page today...?" has A "Step 1, Ground truth: install, quotas, terms, output schema: Pin what Gemini CLI actually is today...". The question text is visible on the page (254/254 found), so it is not hidden-markup, but mismatched Q/A is a structured-data quality risk.
findings.fix: scripts/build_seo.py: either drop FAQPage, or generate genuine reader questions with the answer paragraph that actually answers them (the "In two sentences" lede is a good A for "What is <tool>?"). If kept, keep it for AI answer engines only and make sure each answer is the visible text under that question.
findings.expected_impact: Removes a low-quality structured-data signal; no ranking loss (no rich result today).

findings.title: No real About/author identity for DejaViewed
findings.evidence: /about/ is a Next.js export titled "Career Intelligence System" ("Personal Work Intelligence System — 16 years of professional work") that never mentions DejaViewed and has no canonical. All 108 Article nodes use author = Organization "DejaViewed"; there is no Person, no editorial/method page, no contact page on the domain (contact is only via /go/service -> 1gabe.com/contact). Organization.sameAs lists GitHub and Instagram only.
findings.fix: Add site/about-dejaviewed (or replace /about/) generated by scripts/build_start_here.py-style script: who curates, how entries are processed (transcription, enrichment, AI assistance disclosure), update cadence, contact. scripts/build_seo.py: author -> Person {name, url: about page, sameAs: [github, instagram, 1gabe.com]}, publisher stays Organization; add the about/contact link to the static footer.
findings.expected_impact: Stronger trust signals for YMYL-adjacent topics (quant/trading guides) and for AI answer engines that weigh authorship.

findings.title: Internal agent/process notes are published in guide text
findings.evidence: Phrases leaked into live guides: "this session" in 6 guide/deeper pages, "sandbox blocked git clone" in 3, "clone pending" in 3, "Repo path: repos/..." in 3, "Not cloned locally" in 1. Example (gemini-cli, live): "Repo path: repos/gemini-cli/ (clone pending — sandbox blocked git clone in this session; run git clone ... manually)".
findings.fix: Edit the source markdown for those guides; add a denylist lint to scripts/quality_gate.py (or rebuild.sh) that fails the build on "this session", "sandbox", "repos/", "clone pending", "TODO".
findings.expected_impact: Removes visible low-quality / auto-generated signals that hurt helpful-content assessment.

findings.title: Render-blocking third-party CSS/JS and an unpinned CDN dependency
findings.evidence: Google Fonts stylesheet is render-blocking on every page (Lighthouse est. 888-949 ms); fonts are 72-184 KB (Inter + JetBrains Mono, up to 4 woff2 files on /catalog). display=swap is present (font-display audit passes). Guides load https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked/marked.min.js with NO version and dompurify@3 (major-range): a breaking marked release would blank all 63 guide bodies for users and Googlebot overnight.
findings.fix: Self-host subsetted woff2 (latin) for Inter 400/600/800 and JetBrains Mono 400 under site/fonts/, preload the two above-the-fold files, @font-face in site/shared.css; remove fonts.googleapis.com links from templates. Pin marked@<exact> and dompurify@<exact> in scripts/build_guides.py or remove them entirely via SEO-01.
findings.expected_impact: ~0.5-1 s faster FCP on mobile; eliminates a single point of failure for guide content.

findings.title: No _headers file: static assets cached 4 h, HTML not cached at the edge
findings.evidence: curl: HTML cache-control "public, max-age=0, must-revalidate" (cf-cache-status DYNAMIC); shared.css, catalog.js, /thumb/*.jpg and /og/*.jpg "max-age=14400". site/_headers does not exist.
findings.fix: Add site/_headers: /thumb/* and /og/* -> "Cache-Control: public, max-age=2592000, immutable" (filenames are content ids); /shared.css,/shared.js,/catalog.js -> max-age=86400, stale-while-revalidate=604800 (or fingerprint names in scripts/render_template.py and go immutable).
findings.expected_impact: Faster repeat views and fewer revalidations; small CWV gain.

findings.title: Missing HSTS, CSP and Permissions-Policy
findings.evidence: Live headers on / and /guides/gemini-cli: x-content-type-options: nosniff and referrer-policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin present; Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, Permissions-Policy, X-Frame-Options absent. http:// -> https:// is a 301 (good). No mixed content found (0 http:// src/href in static HTML).
findings.fix: site/_headers "/*": Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(); Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only first (scripts from self, cdn.jsdelivr.net, static.cloudflareinsights.com; fonts.gstatic.com) then enforce; X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN.
findings.expected_impact: Hygiene and Lighthouse best-practices; not a ranking factor beyond HTTPS.

findings.title: Cloudflare Email Obfuscation rewrites "git@github.com" and injects a render-blocking script
findings.evidence: On / and /catalog the string git@github.com is replaced by <a class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail=...> (crawlers see "[email protected]") and /cdn-cgi/scripts/.../email-decode.min.js is added; Lighthouse lists it as render-blocking (est. 720 ms on home, 578 ms on catalog).
findings.fix: Cloudflare dashboard -> Scrape Shield -> Email Address Obfuscation off (no real emails are published), or wrap the clone command in <!--email_off-->...<!--/email_off--> in the template.
findings.expected_impact: Removes one render-blocking request on the two heaviest pages.

findings.title: llms.txt is stale and does not list the guides
findings.evidence: Live /llms.txt (1,072 bytes) says "20 deep-dive guides" (63 exist + 45 deeper), links .html URLs (catalog.html, prompts.html) that redirect, points to /catalog.json rather than /api/catalog.json, and has no per-guide links. Format matches llmstxt.org (H1, blockquote, H2 link lists) but there is no "## Optional" section and no guide/deeper list, which is the main thing an agent wants.
findings.fix: scripts/build_api.py: regenerate llms.txt with live counts, clean URLs, a "## Guides" section (63 lines "- [Title](https://dejaviewed.dev/guides/<slug>): one-line answer"), "## Deeper dives" (45), "## Data" (api/*.json), and "## Optional" (llms-full.txt, feed.xml).
findings.expected_impact: Better agent/answer-engine routing to the strongest pages.

findings.title: Image weight and markup on deeper pages and catalog thumbs
findings.evidence: 464 on deeper pages (e.g. 50 on deeper-insight-claude-mastery): all alt="" (decorative — acceptable for duplicate thumbnails, but they are the only images and carry no text), none have width/height, none use loading="lazy". Catalog: Lighthouse image-delivery saving est. 51 KB, first thumb 126 KB. Thumbs are JPEG only; 155/876 > 100 KB, max 2 MB. A corrupt stray file site/thumb/DVW9iXtiIty_tmp.jpg is deployed.
findings.fix: scripts/deeper_dives.py: add width/height, loading="lazy" (except first), and alt = entry title. scripts/download_thumbs.py / build_og.py: emit 480w WebP alongside JPEG, cap at ~60 KB; delete *_tmp.jpg from site/thumb in the build.
findings.expected_impact: Lower LCP/CLS risk on image-heavy pages; image-search eligibility.

findings.title: /go/ outbound redirect links carry no rel="sponsored"/"nofollow"
findings.evidence: /go/diy and /go/service appear on 961 pages; tool /go/ links on dozens (e.g. /go/blender 23 pages). They 302 to external sites (all pending today, per build_monetize). When any becomes an affiliate URL, Google's link-spam policy requires rel="sponsored". 0 external links in the site use nofollow/ugc/sponsored. 15 target=_blank links on /links lack rel=noopener (modern browsers imply it).
findings.fix: scripts/build_monetize.py: emit rel="sponsored nofollow" on every /go/ link now (pending or active) and optionally add "Disallow: /go/" to site/robots.txt so crawlers do not spend budget on redirect hops.
findings.expected_impact: Compliance before monetization goes live; no ranking downside.

findings.title: Minor schema notes: retired SearchAction, Dataset license claim
findings.evidence: WebSite.potentialAction SearchAction (/search?q=) is valid, but Google retired the sitelinks search box in Nov 2024, so it has no SERP effect. Dataset node on / and /catalog declares license https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT while its own description says original posts remain the property of their creators — the dataset includes third-party captions/transcripts, so an MIT claim is inaccurate for those fields and could matter for Google Dataset Search.
findings.fix: scripts/build_seo.py: keep SearchAction (harmless) or drop it; scope the Dataset license to the metadata/code (e.g. CC BY 4.0 for curation fields) and state that source content is linked, not relicensed.
findings.expected_impact: Accuracy; low ranking impact.

findings.title: Cloudflare bot features inject hidden links and challenge JS into HTML
findings.evidence: For unverified clients (including a spoofed Googlebot UA) Cloudflare injects <a href="/cdn-cgi/content?id=..." aria-hidden rel="nofollow" style="display:none"> (AI Labyrinth) and /cdn-cgi/challenge-platform JS. GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and CCBot UAs received 200 with full HTML. Could not verify behaviour for verified Googlebot from this machine (cannot originate from Google IPs); Cloudflare documents that verified crawlers are excluded.
findings.fix: No action required; check Cloudflare Security -> Bots that "Block AI bots" stays off (robots.txt welcomes them) and watch GSC Crawl Stats for /cdn-cgi/ fetches.
findings.expected_impact: Informational.

findings.title: Citations and answer-first coverage
findings.evidence: Guide markdown carries a median of 22 external links, but 7 of 63 guides have zero outbound citations. "In two sentences" answer lede is present in 63/63 guides on disk (another agent is adding/refining it — in progress, not double-reported). lang="en" on all 970 pages; no hreflang needed (single language). Feed: valid RSS 2.0 with atom:self, 75 items, all pubDates RFC-822 parseable, no duplicate guids.
findings.fix: scripts/build_guides.py / quality_gate.py: warn when a guide has fewer than 3 primary-source links (official docs, repo, paper).
findings.expected_impact: AEO trust; answer engines prefer cited claims.

lighthouse._meta: Lighthouse 13.5.0, mobile preset (default throttling), headless Chrome, single run each on 2026-10-22; expect +-10 point run-to-run variance.

distributions.scope: computed over all 966 indexable HTML pages in site/ (excludes pagefind/, legacy/, about/_next, ai_presentation/, doetug/, and 4 noindex pages)

word_count.note: server-HTML visible words, scripts/hidden prerender removed; for guides the markdown word count is used because the body is client-rendered

crawl_depth.note: BFS from / over static <a href> in site/ HTML (no JS execution; nav injected by shared.js is NOT counted)
